limitations: Pixel checks establish extraction and separation, not acting quality or natural motion.
Faint alpha values below 8/255 are ignored only for feature detection. All nonzero alpha and visible RGB remain exact.
Derived display PNGs normalize RGB to zero only where alpha already equals zero. Before/after appearance and alpha hashes prove no visible change; source PNGs remain immutable.
Where feature bounds overlap, disconnected ink component masks isolate the existing drawing. Only hidden RGB at alpha zero is excluded from layer reconstruction comparisons.
Whole faces are registered with recorded integer translations; drawings are never scaled or warped.
Loop seams, blink arcs, emotion and registration need independent visual review.
Review assets are not connected to live voice in this pass.
